sender: Dr. Mitsuki Sato (佐藤 美月) <m.sato@sakuraclinic-example.jp>
subject: Adverse event report from our clinic in Japan (form in Japanese, attached)
bodyText:
Dear Safety Team,

I am reporting an adverse event on behalf of our clinic in Japan. Our standard reporting
form is completed in Japanese - please see the attached PDF for the full report.

Briefly: a 47-year-old male patient developed a widespread rash and strong itching
approximately 12 days after starting Nortavex 40 mg daily, along with a mild fever
(37.8C). Symptoms gradually improved over 5 days after the medication was stopped, and
hospitalization was not required.

Please let us know if a full English translation is needed for your internal review, or
if your team is able to process the Japanese form directly.

Best regards,
Dr. Mitsuki Sato
Sakura Naika Clinic
